name: Ambiguous-Success Reconciliation Verification
problemStatement: An outbox command was submitted and processed by the downstream service (e.g. task transitioned to human_review in DB / workflow started), but the worker process crashed or network connection dropped before outboxRepo.markDelivered was written.

reconciliationMechanism.step1: Outbox consumer re-leases the unacknowledged command (state=leased, attempts=1).
reconciliationMechanism.step2: TaskWorkflowDispatcher checks if downstream entity already reflects confirmed progress matching cmd.aggregate_id or cmd.idempotency_key.
reconciliationMechanism.step3: Dispatcher observes task.state is already 'human_review' (prior execution succeeded).
reconciliationMechanism.step4: Dispatcher synthesizes confirmed reconciliation receipt without re-running workflow or repeating external effects.
reconciliationMechanism.step5: Outbox consumer marks command delivered in PostgreSQL with real timestamp.

testEvidence.testName: proves ambiguous-success reconciliation when external progress exists but outbox delivery was unacknowledged
